title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Google Cloud
providers.scope_notes: Covers Google Cloud (IAM, API Keys, Cloud Storage). Covers Google Cloud project/org credentials; org policy constraints and VPC Service Controls need an organization resource; Workspace user OAuth and domain-wide delegation are in the separate `google` platform.

controls.name: iam.serviceAccountKeyExposureResponse
controls.what: Auto-disables SA keys and SA-bound API keys that Google detects as exposed.

controls.name: Disable service account (serviceAccounts.disable)
controls.what: Immediately disables the SA, which is the documented way to cut off already-issued short-lived tokens.

controls.name: iam.managed.disableServiceAccountApiKeyCreation
controls.what: Blocks binding API keys to service accounts except for allowed services.
controls.setting: Organization policies > Block service account API key bindings

controls.name: API key application and API restrictions
controls.what: Restricts a key to listed external IPs, referrers or apps, and to specific APIs.
controls.setting: APIs & Services > Credentials > key > Application restrictions / API restrictions

controls.name: Delete API key
controls.what: Deletes the key; it can be restored for 30 days.

controls.name: VPC Service Controls
controls.what: Service perimeters with ingress rules limit API access by network origin and identity, even with stolen credentials.

auth_paths.name: API keys (standard keys and authorization keys bound to a service account)

authentication.summary: A bearer string (AIza...) sent with requests. Standard keys only identify a project for billing/quota; authorization keys act as the bound service account, similar to a long-lived access token.

federation.details: Standard keys identify no principal; authorization keys act as a service account. Neither is tied to user SSO.

ip_restriction.boundary: Per-key application restrictions (external IPs, referrers, Android/iOS apps) and API restrictions. Keys created by REST API are unrestricted unless set. Internal IPs are not supported.

lifetime.summary: No expiry setting found on fetched pages

renewal.summary: Console 'Rotate key' creates a new key with the same restrictions; then delete the old one.

administration.summary: Binding keys to service accounts is blocked by a default org policy (Gemini API allowed by default). Standard key creation needs serviceusage.apiKeys.create.
administration.conditions: Changing the constraint needs an organization resource.

offboard.details: Standard keys don't identify a principal; authorization keys act as a service account.

inventory.details: Cloud Asset Inventory supports apikeys.googleapis.com/Key; per project also gcloud services api-keys list.

usage.ui: Logs Explorer: protoPayload.serviceName="apikeys.googleapis.com" (CreateKey/DeleteKey/UpdateKey are Admin Activity; GetKeyString needs Data Access Admin Read enabled)

log_sources.name: Cloud Audit Logs (apikeys.googleapis.com)
log_sources.notes: CreateKey/DeleteKey/UpdateKey are Admin Activity; GetKeyString is Data Access.

credential_id_fields.notes: Docs say authorization keys obscure end-user identity; data-plane key field not documented.

lifecycle_events.notes: Someone read the key string; Data Access

anomaly_cues: Authorization key created after constraint change

containment.steps: Delete the key (or add restrictions); for authorization keys also disable the bound SA.
containment.notes: Propagation time for deletion not documented.

unknown: Which log field shows the API key on API calls
No documented whoami for API keys; reachable APIs depend on key restrictions
